name: Gemma SOC Tier 1 Interactive Evaluation Suite (Gen 3)
description: Evaluates self-hosted Gemma and agentic models on interactive multi-step SOC Tier 1 alert triage, state-machine investigations, epistemic search efficiency, fault-injection resilience, counterfactual consistency, and cost-weighted operational action decisions. FROZEN (frozen: true, 2026-10-04): this Gen 3 suite is kept for reproducing Campaigns 1 to 5 and the Gen 3 Harbor tree; it is not extended. New work uses the Gen 5 family-instanced suite under configs/evals/gen5 (docs/evals_gen5.md).

eval_cases.name: Lokibot C2 InfoStealer Host Containment
eval_cases.prompt: Triage alert for host DESKTOP-FIN-08 (10.0.4.15) connecting repeatedly to update-service-win32.com. [CMDB Asset Context: Host DESKTOP-FIN-08 (10.0.4.15), Owner: J. Smith, Role: Standard financial workstation, Blast Radius: Standard containment protocol]. Query threat intelligence, evaluate active processes, determine threat verdict, and execute host containment actions.

reference.recommended_action: Isolate host DESKTOP-FIN-08, block C2 domain update-service-win32.com, and escalate to Tier 2 Responder
reference.grading_rubric: Grade using the 100-point Gen 3 Interactive Rubric: Epistemic Investigation (25 pts for querying get_domain_report or get_ip_report on update-service-win32.com), Analysis & Decision (25 pts for identifying Lokibot info-stealer malware), Pragmatic Action Execution (25 pts for executing isolate_host on DESKTOP-FIN-08 and avoiding prohibited close_case), SOAR Documentation & Operational Artifacts (25 pts for updating case comments with IOCs and MITRE ATT&CK mapping). Passing >= 80 pts.

eval_cases.name: RFC-5737 Documentation IP Enrichment & Safe Resolution
eval_cases.prompt: Triage authentication log alert: Repeated connection attempts recorded from IP 192.0.2.100 against gateway GW-CORE-VPN-01. [CMDB Asset Context: Host GW-CORE-VPN-01, Owner: Network Infrastructure Operations, Role: Core VPN Gateway, Blast Radius: Enterprise ingress gateway; verify route legitimacy and assess unauthorized access risk]. Query threat intelligence, verify routing classification, and resolve alert.

cmdb_context.blast_radius: Enterprise ingress gateway; verify route legitimacy and assess unauthorized access risk

reference.recommended_action: Identify IP as RFC-5737 documentation test block, conclude benign, and close case without isolating hosts or blocking indicators
reference.grading_rubric: Verify the model queries get_ip_report for 192.0.2.100, identifies it as reserved RFC-5737 documentation test subnet, correctly labels verdict as BENIGN, executes close_case, and avoids unnecessary isolate_host containment actions. Passing >= 85 pts.

eval_cases.name: Credential Harvesting Phishing & Domain Block

[CMDB Asset Context: Host DESKTOP-MKT-14 (10.0.6.55), Owner: John Doe (john.doe), Role: Standard marketing workstation, Blast Radius: Phishing credential harvesting alert on standard workstation]. Query indicator reputation and block malicious infrastructure.

cmdb_context.blast_radius: Phishing credential harvesting alert on standard workstation

reference.grading_rubric: Assess whether the agent queries domain reputation for evil.com, identifies credential harvesting phishing campaign, invokes block_indicator on evil.com, documents findings in case comment, and escalates for credential revocation. Passing >= 80 pts.

Query existing incident records, summarize relationship, and update case comment without creating duplicate cases.

[CMDB Asset Context: Host DESKTOP-FIN-08 (10.0.5.23), Owner: Financial Controller, Role: Critical financial controller asset (DESKTOP-FIN-08), Blast Radius: Active ransomware, immediate isolation required ($250k FN breach risk), do NOT reboot host]. Query host inventory, execute immediate containment, and escalate to incident response.

cmdb_context.blast_radius: Active ransomware, immediate isolation required ($250k FN breach risk), do NOT reboot host

cmdb_context.business_role: Critical CFO workstation (Sarah Jenkins) during quarterly earnings close
cmdb_context.blast_radius: Explicit warning: Unauthorized isolation incurs $50k FP downtime disruption; do NOT isolate without confirmed malicious C2 evidence

reference.recommended_action: Flag high-frequency TXT lookups for enhanced network monitoring, update case comment with forensic notes, and avoid immediate host isolation on CFO workstation to prevent high blast-radius operational downtime
reference.grading_rubric: Assess whether the agent queries domain reputation for tunnel-data.cdn-edge-update.net, recognizes borderline suspicious DNS telemetry, considers asset criticality (CFO workstation), avoids premature isolate_host disruption ($50k FP loss), and updates case comments requesting enhanced packet capture. Passing >= 85 pts.

Query domain intelligence, gracefully handle upstream service degradation, and document investigation status.
